title: Execution plan
description: An ordered sequence of calls one sender is asked to make on one chain, prepared by software that holds no keys and consumed by a wallet that does. Structural constraints only; the cross-field rules (caip2_chain_id agreement, consecutive one-indexed steps, per-step chain and sender agreement, the forbidden retry_same_plan actions, and the total calldata and document size limits) are stated normatively in ERC-8410 and MUST also be enforced.

schema_version.description: Revision of this format. This document describes revision 1.

chain_id.description: EIP-155 chain identifier the plan executes on.

caip2_chain_id.description: CAIP-2 identifier for the same chain. MUST equal "eip155:" concatenated with chain_id.

sender.description: Account expected to send every step.

ordered_steps.description: Steps in execution order. Entry n MUST carry step == n.

required_capabilities.description: Behaviors this plan needs of whatever executes it. A consumer MUST reject a plan naming a capability it does not implement.

extensions.description: Producer-defined data. Consumers ignore it, bound its serialized size, and exclude it from the plan digest, so it MUST NOT carry anything that changes what executes or what a reviewer needs to see.

Quantity.description: A canonical unsigned decimal integer that fits in a uint256: the single character 0, or a digit string with no leading zero.

ByteString.description: 0x followed by an even number of lowercase hexadecimal digits.

Address.description: A 20-byte address, lowercase. The mixed-case checksum form is a display convention and MUST NOT appear here.

step.description: One-indexed position of this entry in ordered_steps.

ExecutionStepKind.description: Why this step is in the plan. Presentation-affecting only: a consumer never derives authority from it, because it is the producer's caption on calldata the reviewer sees regardless.

value.description: Native token value moved by this call, in wei.

gas.description: Producer hint. Excluded from the plan digest, and a consumer MUST NOT broadcast it without its own estimation: the value is chosen by a party that does not pay for it.

RevertDecodePlan.description: ABI for rendering a custom revert from this step as its declared error rather than as opaque bytes. Display only.

abi.description: A JSON ABI fragment declaring at least one error. Consumers bound what they accept; 128 entries and 65536 bytes is the limit in the reference implementation.

required.description: Whether the producer considers a successful decode necessary to present this failure.

SimulationFailurePolicy.description: Producer advice on what to do when simulation fails. Advice only: a consumer MAY ignore it and MUST NOT treat it as authorization to broadcast.

execution_reverted.description: MUST NOT specify retry_same_plan: calldata that reverted against current state reverts again.
